message: Kotlin writes ${k.rootId} into the HTML as it is. If it can hold text from outside, build the string with interpolate(...), which escapes it. The fix passes ${customCss.orEmpty()}, in a <style>, as Trusted(...).

Kotlin writes ${customCss.orEmpty()} into a script or style element, which the browser runs, so escaping does not help. Put the value in a data-* attribute and read it from there. CSS you wrote yourself can be passed to interpolate(...) as Trusted(...).

Kotlin writes ${k.contentId} into the HTML as it is. If it can hold text from outside, build the string with interpolate(...), which escapes it. The fix passes ${customCss.orEmpty()}, in a <style>, as Trusted(...).

Kotlin writes $bodyHtml into the HTML as it is. If it can hold text from outside, build the string with interpolate(...), which escapes it; if it is markup you built, declare it Html or wrap it in Trusted(...). The fix passes ${customCss.orEmpty()}, in a <style>, as Trusted(...).
